ticket.title: Render a task's own pending decisions in the human briefing
ticket.description: Repro: from a repo with a decision-blocked task run ask-decision on it, then show it. The human output omits the pending decision entirely, while show --json carries it under task.decisions (status, category, proposed_options). Evidence: format_task_briefing renders inherited_decisions only, and there is no reference to .decisions anywhere in storypole-cli, so a task's own decision is never printed. Observed against AF-17 and AF-18 in the aerofoil backlog on storypole 0.1.0-beta.2 and still present on main at 09557e7.
acceptance_criteria:
DONE 2026-11-06, commit 50247d3 (storypole).

The human briefing now prints the task's own decisions, unresolved first, with the proposed options listed for any pending one. Before this it printed only decisions inherited from linked tasks, so the very question blocking the work was invisible in the briefing meant to state what blocks the work. The data was never missing: TaskNode.decisions has been populated all along and no renderer read it.

Ordering and option-printing are the substance, not the formatting: a question the operator must answer outranks a decision already made, and a briefing that asks something it gives no way to answer is only half a briefing.

Three tests: pending decision prints its options; unresolved sorts before resolved; a task with no decisions adds nothing. The renderer lives in format_decisions.rs (88 lines) because format.rs was already at 193 and the tests would have crossed the 250-line limit.

Tier 2: fmt clean, clippy -p storypole-cli --all-targets -D warnings clean, 3 tests green.

Note: recording it here because it is the shape of SP-4 itself - this ticket was recovered from a legacy ledger during GB-260's archive, so it is the one ticket in the queue that existed nowhere else.
